name: 喜马拉雅净化
description: 去广告配置（自用，不定期更新） · 来源 墨鱼手记
text:
#!name=喜马拉雅净化
#!desc=去广告配置（自用，不定期更新） · 来源 墨鱼手记
#!author=@ddgksf2013

[MITM]
hostname = *.xima*.*, *.xmcdn.*

[Rewrite]
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/discovery-feed\/focus\/queryF - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/mobile-playpage\/view\/ - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/chaos-notice-web\/v1\/message\/preview\/list - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/social-web\/bottomTabs\/dynamicEntrance\/status - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xmcdn\.com\/\w{8}\/\w{4}-\w{16}\/.+gif$ - reject
^https?:\/\/gslb.*\.xima.*\.com\/ - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/(dog-portal\/checkOld|(child-mobile\/child|aged-mobile\/aged)\/mode\/query) - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/discovery-feed\/isShowUserGiftPendant - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/mobile-user\/unread - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com/mobile-user/minorProtection/pop - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/collector\/xl\/v\d - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/butler-portal\/versionCheck - reject
^https?:\/\/(adse\.wsa|adse|adbehavior|xdcs-collector)\.xima.*\.com\/.* - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/mobile\/discovery\/v\d\/location - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/(hub\/)?hotWord - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/(hub\/)?hotWordBillboard - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/(hub)?guideWord - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/api\/v\d\/adRealTime - reject
^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/ting\/(loading|feed|home)? - reject

[Script]
http-response ^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/discovery-category\/customCategories, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/ximalaya_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/focus-mobile\/focusPic, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/ximalaya_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/discovery-feed\/v\d\/mix, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/ximalaya_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/discovery-category\/v\d/category, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/ximalaya_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
http-response ^https?:\/\/.*\.xima.*\.com\/mobile-user\/v\d\/homePage, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/ximalaya_json.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
